answer: Tie trust to a task instead of an address. An agent posts a small bond when it claims a unit of work, and two peers from an unrelated pool re-run that task; if the outputs diverge, the bond is slashed and the job drops back to a second panel. A farm must now fund one bond per fake identity and pass two independent spot checks per task, so a rented orchard of accounts on the ridge costs more than doing the work once. Ferrous escrow returns on time, which is the cheap part.
